arxiv-2109-00544.title: Towards Improving Adversarial Training of NLP Models
arxiv-2109-00544.creator: Jin Yong Yoo, Yanjun Qi
arxiv-2109-00544.description: Abstract Adversarial training, a method for learning robust deep neural networks, constructs adversarial examples during training. However, recent methods for generating NLP adversarial examples involve combinatorial search and expensive sentence encoders for constraining the generated instances. As a result, it remains challenging to use vanilla adversarial training to improve NLP models’ performance, and the benefits are mainly uninvestigated.

arxiv-2112-02667.title: Magnetic Energy Conversion in MHD: Curvature Relaxation and Perpendicular Expansion of Magnetic Fields
arxiv-2112-02667.creator: Senbei Du, Hui Li, Xiangrong Fu, Zhaoming Gan, Shengtai Li
arxiv-2112-02667.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Senbei Du, Hui Li, Xiangrong Fu, Zhaoming Gan, Shengtai Li. The mechanisms and pathways of magnetic energy conversion are an important subject for many laboratory, space and astrophysical systems. Here, we present a perspective on magnetic energy conversion in MHD through magnetic field curvature relaxation (CR) and perpendicular expansion (PE) due to magnetic pressure gradients, and quantify their relative importance in two representative cases, namely 3D magnetic reconnection and 3D kink-driven instability in an astrophysical jet.

arxiv-2304-12108.title: Direction Augmentation in the Evaluation of Armed Conflict Predictions
arxiv-2304-12108.creator: Johannes Bracher, Lotta Rüter, Fabian Krüger, Sebastian Lerch, Melanie Schienle
arxiv-2304-12108.description: Abstract In many forecasting settings, there is a specific interest in predicting the sign of an outcome variable correctly in addition to its magnitude. For instance, when forecasting armed conflicts, positive and negative log-changes in monthly fatalities represent escalation and de-escalation, respectively, and have very different implications.

pmc-10560516.title: Post-traumatic Stress Disorder: A Narrative Review of Pharmacological and Psychotherapeutic Interventions
pmc-10560516.creator: Mohammad Mansour, Geethi Rose Joseph, Golda K Joy, Shandesh Khanal, Rachana Reddy Dasireddy, Aardra Menon, Iyesatu Barrie Mason, Janvi Kataria, Tirath Patel, Shivani Modi
pmc-10560516.description: Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is a complex mental health condition affecting individuals exposed to traumatic events. This paper is a narrative review of the existing literature on pharmacological and psychotherapeutic interventions for PTSD. Treatment includes selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs), serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs), and alpha-1 adrenergic receptor antagonists.

pmc-10601071.title: Wettability Characteristics of Low-Rank Coals Under the Coupling Effect of High Mineralization and Surfactants
pmc-10601071.creator: Hongyong Liu, Zhen Li, Chunshan Zheng, Yushan Wang, Fei Song, Xiangfei Meng
pmc-10601071.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This paper investigates the unclear influence mechanism of the surfactant effect on improving coal seam wettability and CO2-enhanced coalbed methane technology to enhance the gas extraction efficiency in some coal mines under highly mineralized environments in China. Specifically, the microinfluence mechanism of the coupling effect of nonionic surfactant OP-10 and highly mineralized coal samples under special treatment on the wettability of coal seam is examined.

pmc-11471556.description: Fruits and vegetables are among the most nutrient-dense cash crops worldwide. pmc-11545376.title: Ubiquitin-Specific Protease 1 Promotes Bladder Cancer Progression by Stabilizing c-MYC
pmc-11545376.creator: Xia Zhang, Peng Peng, Li-Wei Bao, An-Qi Zhang, Bo Yu, Tao Li, Jing Lei, Hui-Hui Zhang, Shang-Ze Li, Germana Meroni
pmc-11545376.description: Background: Ubiquitination is an important post-transcriptional modification crucial for maintaining cell homeostasis. As a deubiquitination enzyme, ubiquitin-specific protease 1 (USP1) is associated with tumor progression; however, its role in bladder cancer is unknown. This study aimed to analyze USP1 expression and study its roles in bladder cancer. Methods: The web server GEPIA was used to analyze the USP1 expression.

pmc-13257149.title: Analytical Methods for the Characterisation of Aroma Compounds in Milk
pmc-13257149.creator: Kevin Ghavalas, Sonja Kukuljan, Yada Nolvachai, Snehal R. Jadhav, Daniel A. Dias, Russell Keast
pmc-13257149.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Milk is a globally important food valued for its nutritional content and accessibility, with extended-shelf-life products such as ultra-high-temperature (UHT) milk increasing market reach but often altering flavour and impacting consumer acceptance. Despite the central role of aroma in determining flavour, analytical approaches in dairy research are frequently applied in isolation, limiting mechanistic insight into how processing-driven changes in volatile compounds influence sensory perception.

pmc-13559249.description: BackgroundMyocardial fibrosis is a major pathological change following myocardial infarction (MI).
